key_insight: Mangrove wave attenuation is not well captured by uniform vegetation models because root biomass varies with height and creates species-dependent, frequency-selective drag.
engineering_relevance: The paper provides a simplified, parameterized mangrove representation that can be used in CFD and physical experiments to design more realistic coastal protection models.
method: Generalized the vertical vegetation/biomass profile across mangrove species.
Derived a wave attenuation model that explicitly includes mangrove root characteristics.
Built a simplified drag-profile-preserving mangrove surrogate for OpenFOAM and fabrication.
evidence_signal: OpenFOAM simulations were used to evaluate hydrodynamic performance, showing frequency-selective and species-dependent attenuation behavior.
watch_item: The model is still a simplification of complex root-flow interactions, so calibration to species- and site-specific morphology is likely needed.
paper_title: On the Modelling of the Hydrodynamic Drag of Mangroves
